display_long_description:
Room Remix is an interior decorating app that helps you visualize improvements to your space before you make them in real life. See furniture, art, décor, and layout ideas overlaid directly on your real room, making it easy to imagine what could work—and what won’t—without the guesswork.

Try out new furniture and artwork, rearrange your space in seconds, and experiment with different styles and layouts using intuitive hand controls. Move, rotate, resize, and swap objects freely while exploring everything from subtle refreshes to bold redesigns. Built-in measurement tools help you understand your space, plan purchases, and avoid sizing mistakes.

Room Remix also features an AI design assistant that can see your room and offer custom decorating advice. Ask questions, get styling ideas, compare layouts, and receive personalized recommendations based on your space, taste, and goals.

Whether you’re refreshing a room, planning a makeover, or just playing with ideas, Room Remix makes interior decorating more visual, creative, and confidence-boosting using mixed reality.
